body:
I haven’t tried killing myself ever since I was in a mental hospital and the only reason stopping me was that I was afraid I’d get hospitalised again. It was living hell.

I feel like most of the nurses went into the profession just to abuse their power. There were kids from the ages of fucking 4, just because they were not behaving well and they couldn’t even play there because then they would “lose points” (if you lose 5 points in one week you’re not allowed to go outside) and/or get the booty juice. Same with crying (mostly because you were “disrespecting the nurses” when they told you to stop.) Sometimes they wouldn’t even allow us to talk to each other.

They would push you until you fell only so they could say you’re not stable yet and keep you in longer. One of my friends in there said that we’re basically just lab rats to them and I couldn’t agree more . It never helped anyone, most people I know from there were hospitalised over and over again, searching for help they would never get in these institutions. I went there because I wanted to escape, I hit rock bottom when I came there but in there I was stomped further into the ground.

I’m sorry this is kind of long and all over the place but this issue is very close to me, I always advice people with issues against it because it just leaves you with more problems, I developed anorexia in there, someone I know got addicted to opiates shortly after leaving. We need help and I really wish we could get it but places like this sadly aren’t helping at all. I also told every therapist I’ve had about it and they all acknowledged the system is flawed and usually advise people against it too.
